• Overall inflation rate was high in mid 2017 reaching a high of
11.7% in the month of May.
• The spike in overall inflation was driven by high food prices
resulting in a 20% food inflation rate in May 2017 due to drought
experienced in early 2017.
• However, by December 2017, food inflation had fallen to 4.9%,
hence pulling down overall inflation rate to 4.5%.
• In 2018, the outlook on inflation is positive
The forecast for the long rains (March to May) indicate
that the country’s food basket regions (Western, Central,
Rift Valley) will experience near-normal rainfall in both
space and time.
Of the Seven Forks dams, only Masinga (40MW) may
struggle with low water levels and thus negligible impact
on overall Hydro-electricity generation.
